scenarios.title: A｜解释自己的想法
scenarios.setting: 经理希望采用方案 A，但玩家认为另一个方案更合适。

turns.text: I think we should go with the first option. It’s simpler and we can finish it faster.

turns.prompt: 你想表示理解对方的解释或立场，会怎么说？

choices.text: I understand. Could I explain why I think the second option might work better?

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. Could I explain why I think the second option might work better?
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: I see your point, but I have a slightly different idea.

feedback.naturalExpression: I see your point, but I have a slightly different idea.
feedback.explanation: 先承认听懂了对方，再提出自己的顾虑；理解对方的理由并不等于完全同意。

choices.text: I was thinking we might get a better result with the second option.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was thinking we might get a better result with the second option.
feedback.explanation: “I was thinking”把想法作为尚在考虑的建议提出，方便一起讨论。

choices.text: Can I walk you through my reasoning?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I walk you through my reasoning?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: I think my idea is better than yours.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. Could I explain why I think the second option might work better?
feedback.explanation: “better than yours”容易变成个人比较；指出方案在哪个成本、时间或效果上更好，更有说服力。

turns.prompt: 关于「与领导意见不一致」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: The first option is faster, but I think we may have to redo some of the work later.

feedback.naturalExpression: The first option is faster, but I think we may have to redo some of the work later.
feedback.explanation: “have to”表示有必要或受条件限制必须这样做，可用于核实办理要求。

choices.text: My main concern is that the first option doesn’t solve the underlying problem.

feedback.naturalExpression: My main concern is that the first option doesn’t solve the underlying problem.
feedback.explanation: “my main concern”指出自己最主要的顾虑，让讨论聚焦重点。

choices.text: The second option would take longer now, but it might save us time later.

feedback.naturalExpression: The second option would take longer now, but it might save us time later.
feedback.explanation: 转折后的内容说明当前需要注意的不同情况，能把顾虑或限制说清楚。

choices.text: I put together a quick comparison. Would you like to take a look?

feedback.naturalExpression: I put together a quick comparison. Would you like to take a look?
feedback.explanation: 先询问对方的意愿或偏好，再作安排，让对方参与选择。

turns.text: That’s a fair point, but we don’t have much time.

turns.prompt: 你想在讨论分歧后提出缩小方案范围的建议，会怎么说？

choices.text: In that case, could we simplify the second option?

feedback.naturalExpression: In that case, could we simplify the second option?
feedback.explanation: “in that case”表示根据刚得知的情况调整方案，让前后决定衔接起来。

choices.text: What if we only implemented the most important part for now?

feedback.naturalExpression: What if we only implemented the most important part for now?
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

choices.text: That makes sense. Maybe there’s a middle ground.

feedback.naturalExpression: That makes sense. Maybe there’s a middle ground.
feedback.explanation: 表示已经听懂或理解原因，给对方一个确认信号。

scenarios.title: B｜收到负面反馈
scenarios.setting: 经理看完玩家提交的工作后，认为结果没有达到要求。

turns.text: I looked at your work, and honestly, this isn’t quite what I was expecting.

turns.prompt: 你想请对方把负面反馈说得更具体，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. Could you tell me which parts aren’t working?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Could you tell me which parts aren’t working?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Thanks for letting me know. What would you like me to change?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for letting me know. What would you like me to change?
feedback.explanation: 先询问对方的意愿或偏好，再作安排，让对方参与选择。

choices.text: I see. Could you give me a little more specific feedback?

feedback.naturalExpression: I see. Could you give me a little more specific feedback?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Was the main issue with the content or the overall direction?

feedback.naturalExpression: Was the main issue with the content or the overall direction?
feedback.explanation: 把两种可能列出来请对方确认，适合核对自己拿不准的细节。

choices.text: But I did exactly what you told me.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Could you tell me which parts aren’t working?
feedback.explanation: 这句强调自己只是按指示做，可能显得防御；先确认反馈，再说明执行依据，更便于一起修正。

turns.text: The overall direction is fine, but it feels unfinished. Some of the details need more attention.

turns.prompt: 你想确认改进工作时应先处理哪些部分，会怎么说？

choices.text: Got it. Which areas would you like me to focus on first?

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Which areas would you like me to focus on first?
feedback.explanation: 先询问对方的意愿或偏好，再作安排，让对方参与选择。

choices.text: Okay, I can go back and refine the details.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I can go back and refine the details.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Would it help if I showed you another version before I finish everything?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it help if I showed you another version before I finish everything?
feedback.explanation: “version”指版本，说明具体版本能避免双方使用不同文件。

choices.text: I think I understand. Could I check in with you again after I revise the first section?

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I understand. Could I check in with you again after I revise the first section?
feedback.explanation: “check in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

turns.text: Yes. Update the first section and send it to me this afternoon.

turns.prompt: 关于「与领导意见不一致」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. I’ll revise that first and send it over.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. I’ll revise that first and send it over.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Got it. I’ll use your feedback and send you an updated version this afternoon.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. I’ll use your feedback and send you an updated version this afternoon.
feedback.explanation: “version”指版本，说明具体版本能避免双方使用不同文件。

scenarios.title: C｜坚持不同意见
scenarios.setting: 玩家已经解释过自己的想法，但经理仍倾向另一个方案。

turns.text: I understand your concern, but I still think we should launch it this week.

turns.prompt: 你想说明对提前上线仍有哪些顾虑，会怎么说？

choices.text: I understand, but I still have some concerns about launching this early.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand, but I still have some concerns about launching this early.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: I respect the decision, but I’d like to raise one concern before we move forward.

feedback.naturalExpression: I respect the decision, but I’d like to raise one concern before we move forward.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I still think we should address the biggest issue before launch.

feedback.naturalExpression: I still think we should address the biggest issue before launch.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: Could we look at the test results once more before making the final decision?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could we look at the test results once more before making the final decision?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: I still don’t agree with you.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I understand, but I still have some concerns about launching this early.
feedback.explanation: 这句能明确保留异议，并非不礼貌；补充尚未解决的具体顾虑，讨论才有继续的方向。

turns.text: What exactly are you worried about?

turns.prompt: 你想用测试中反复出现的问题支持自己的看法，会怎么说？

choices.text: We’ve seen the same problem in several tests, so I don’t think it’s an isolated issue.

feedback.naturalExpression: We’ve seen the same problem in several tests, so I don’t think it’s an isolated issue.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: My concern is that fixing it after launch could be much more difficult.

feedback.naturalExpression: My concern is that fixing it after launch could be much more difficult.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: I think the risk is significant enough that we should discuss it once more.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think the risk is significant enough that we should discuss it once more.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: If we still decide to launch, I’d at least recommend having a backup plan.

feedback.naturalExpression: If we still decide to launch, I’d at least recommend having a backup plan.
feedback.explanation: “at least”表示最低数量或程度，能说明可接受的下限。

turns.text: I understand. Let’s review the issue one more time this afternoon.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. I think that’s worth doing.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I think that’s worth doing.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I appreciate it. I’ll prepare the test results before the meeting.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate it. I’ll prepare the test results before the meeting.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。
